candidates.content_text:
About the Role
PCP Solutions is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Graduate Civil Engineer to join our growing team.
This is an excellent opportunity for a recent engineering graduate or someone in the early stages of their career to gain valuable hands-on experience working on large-scale civil infrastructure projects.
Working alongside experienced Project Managers, Site Engineers and Supervisors, you will assist with the planning, coordination, quality assurance and delivery of civil construction works from commencement through to completion.
The successful applicant will be provided with ongoing guidance and support while developing their technical knowledge, project management skills and practical understanding of civil construction operations.
The Company
PCP Solutions is a leading civil earthworks and commercial plumbing business based in Toowoomba, delivering projects across South East Queensland.
With over 70 staff, PCP Solutions specialises in large-scale infrastructure works for Tier 1 contractors whilst maintaining a supportive, family-focused culture.
We pride ourselves on delivering quality projects, building strong working relationships and providing opportunities for our employees to grow and develop within the business.
Key Responsibilities
Working under the guidance of senior project personnel, your responsibilities will include:
- Assist with daily site inspections and monitoring construction activities.
- Prepare, maintain and complete Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and associated quality assurance documentation.
- Assist with the preparation and submission of project reports and documentation to Principal Contractors.
- Support daily work front reporting, progress tracking and construction records.
- Assist with project programming, scheduling and monitoring critical deadlines.
- Provide project administration and engineering support to Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors and Quality and Safety personnel.
- Assist with reviewing construction drawings, specifications and technical documentation.
- Monitor supplier material conformance and ensure materials meet project specifications.
- Assist with quantity calculations, material take-offs and procurement requirements.
- Support the implementation and maintenance of project quality, workplace health and safety and environmental controls.
- Assist with identifying and reporting potential project risks, delays and construction issues.
- Maintain accurate project records, filing systems and document control processes.
- Provide regular project progress updates to the Project Manager and wider project team.
- Ensure compliance with the company's Integrated Management System (IMS), policies and procedures.
Skills and Qualifications
We are looking for someone who is eager to learn, takes initiative and is passionate about developing a career in civil construction.
The successful applicant will ideally possess:
- A completed Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
- Recent graduates and applicants with up to 2 years of industry experience are encouraged to apply.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work professionally with clients, suppliers, subcontractors and site personnel.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate documentation.
- A willingness to learn and develop practical construction and project management skills.
- Basic understanding of civil construction methods, engineering drawings and specifications.
- Sound computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications.
- Ability to work independently when required and contribute positively to a team environment.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and a strong commitment to workplace safety.
- A current driver's licence and Construction White Card, or willingness to obtain a White Card prior to commencing.
- Willingness to travel to regional project locations as required.
Previous experience in civil construction, earthworks, water infrastructure or quality assurance will be highly regarded but is not essential.
What We Offer
- Opportunity to gain hands-on experience on major civil infrastructure projects.
- Mentoring and ongoing support from experienced engineering and construction professionals.
- Exposure to Tier 1 construction projects and industry-leading systems.
- Career development and progression opportunities within a growing company.
- A supportive, family-focused team environment.
- Competitive remuneration based on qualifications and experience.
- A diverse role offering both site-based and project administration experience.
How to Apply
If you are a motivated Graduate Civil Engineer looking to kick-start your career and gain practical experience in the civil construction industry, we would love to hear from you.
Apply via SEEK or email your resume and cover letter to admin@pcpsolutions.com.au
Join PCP Solutions and build your engineering career with a team committed to quality, safety and delivering successful projects.

Why you’ll love working here  
A growing team with exciting opportunities 
Be part of a supportive team where your experience, ideas and contribution are valued. As our Brisbane office expands, you'll have the opportunity to build strong professional relationships, share your knowledge and make a meaningful contribution to our continued success. 
Variety that builds your experience 
Work across residential, commercial and infrastructure projects, gaining exposure to a range of engineering challenges across Queensland. From developing technical solutions to supporting project delivery, you'll have the opportunity to apply your skills across diverse projects and continue expanding your experience. 
Take ownership of your career 
Develop your technical capabilities, take on greater responsibility and learn from experienced engineers and designers. Depending on your experience and interests, you'll have opportunities to lead projects, mentor developing professionals and strengthen your client relationships. 
A great Brisbane location 
Our Fortitude Valley office is conveniently located close to public transport, cafés and restaurants, with easy access to the CBD, New Farm and Howard Smith Wharves. Enjoy a convenient work location while being part of a team delivering quality engineering solutions. 
What’s in it for you?  
- 
Competitive remuneration: a package that reflects your experience and the value you bring.
- 
Flexibility: 9-day fortnight, flexible hours, plus the option to purchase additional leave.
- 
Professional development: CPD support plus mentoring
- 
Recognition and rewards: employee referral rewards and recognition programs that don’t feel like an afterthought.
- 
Inclusive, friendly culture: supportive colleagues, collaborative working relationships and regular social events.
- 
Wellbeing support: access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) when you need it.
- 
Career growth with momentum: real ownership, real development, and room to progress.
- 
Stability & reputation: Join a respected, Australian-owned consultancy with a strong and diverse client base.
The Opportunity
As our Brisbane office continues to grow, we’re looking for an experienced Civil Designer to join our team and play a key role in delivering exciting projects across the region.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Designing earthworks, stormwater drainage and sewer systems for commercial and residential developments
- Creating conceptual and detailed civil designs using 12D Model and AutoCAD, ensuring all design documentation meets project, client and quality requirements.
- Preparing civil design drawings and documentation for Development Applications (DA) and Operational Works (Op Works) applications
- Collaborating with engineers, surveyors and external consultants to develop practical and compliant design solutions
- Conducting site inspections, including subgrade and basecourse proof rolls, sewer testing and on-maintenance inspections
- Incorporating site inspection findings into design documentation and project outcomes
- Supporting feasibility studies, reports and cost estimates
- Ensuring designs comply with relevant codes, legislation and Australian Standards
- Assisting with construction monitoring and inspections to ensure design intent is delivered on site
About you
You’ll bring solid technical capability, initiative and a collaborative approach, along with:
- 6+ years of civil design/drafting experience, preferably within a consulting environment.
- Associate Degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification
- Strong knowledge of design software including 12D Model and AutoCAD
- Knowledge of local and statutory requirements, legislation, and Australian Standards
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Full, unrestricted Australian working rights
About STP Consultants
For more than 20 years, STP Consultants has been helping shape communities across Queensland. As a privately owned, multidisciplinary consultancy, we bring together expertise in Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Hydraulic, Fire and Seismic engineering to deliver a diverse range of projects across the state.
Our values - Potential, Respect, Integrity, Deliver and Engage, guide how we work with our clients and support one another every day.
We’re proud of our approachable leaders, collaborative culture and commitment to technical excellence. At STP, you’ll work alongside experienced professionals in an environment where people are trusted to contribute, share ideas and deliver quality outcomes.

About Us
Intravision, established in 2000, is a proudly Australian-owned provider of AV, cabling, and data communications infrastructure. We deliver end-to-end solutions, including design, installation, testing, and maintenance across audiovisual integration, data communications, fibre optics, security, and data centre infrastructure.
With our head office based in Canberra and operations across Australia and New Zealand, Intravision supports major projects nationwide, working with Government, Defence, Construction, and commercial sectors.
As our Data Centre division continues to grow, we are expanding our team to support major infrastructure projects and emerging technologies.
 The Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Estimator – Digital Infrastructure & Hyperscale Projects to join our expanding Data Centre team.
As demand for advanced computing and AI infrastructure continues to accelerate, Intravision is expanding its involvement in some of the industry's most complex digital infrastructure projects. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to major developments across the Data Centre and hyperscale sectors, including next-generation facilities supporting AI workloads and large-scale GPU computing.
Working across our national operations, you will support our ACT, Sydney, Melbourne and New Zealand teams, partnering with colleagues across estimating, operations and project delivery. The position can be based in either our ACT, Sydney or Melbourne office.
You will be part of a growing team delivering the high-performance fibre and connectivity infrastructure that underpins tomorrow's digital environments. An understanding of AI technology, hyperscale computing and the evolving demands of high-density data centres will be particularly valuable.
 Key Responsibilities
- Supporting estimating activities across Intravision's ACT, Sydney, Melbourne and New Zealand operations.
- Preparing cost estimates for fibre, copper and structured cabling works.
- Analysing tender documentation, technical specifications, drawings and project requirements.
- Undertaking detailed material, equipment and labour take-offs.
- Developing labour allowances, installation approaches and project cost breakdowns.
- Evaluating supplier and subcontractor quotations to establish competitive project pricing.
- Reviewing tender requirements to identify discrepancies, scope gaps and commercial risks.
- Preparing pricing schedules, tender qualifications and supporting submission documentation.
- Liaising with internal stakeholders to validate costs, resources and project assumptions.
- Contributing to estimating strategies and supporting the successful pursuit of major project opportunities.
Qualification, Skills & Experience
- Minimum 5 years' experience in estimating telecommunications, communications, structured cabling or ICT infrastructure projects.
- Strong technical knowledge of fibre optic and copper cabling systems.
- Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, cable schedules and bills of quantities.
- Experience preparing detailed cost estimates and competitive tender submissions.
- Understanding of installation methodologies, labour productivity and project costing.
- Experience in Data Centres, hyperscale or other mission-critical environments will be highly regarded.
- Exposure to AI infrastructure, GPU cluster deployments and high-density computing environments will be advantageous.
Core Attributes
- Strong commercial judgement and analytical thinking.
- High attention to detail and accuracy.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong organisation and time management, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
- A collaborative approach and confidence working with teams across multiple locations.
- Proactive problem-solving skills and the ability to identify risks and develop practical solutions.
- Ability to work independently, take ownership and meet deadlines.
Apply Now!
Ready to take your estimating career into the next generation of digital infrastructure? Join Intravision and help deliver the connectivity supporting tomorrow's AI and hyperscale environments.
Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Your mandate includes the end-to-end management of mobile batch plant operations, where you will take full ownership of mix design innovation, material procurement, and the implementation of rigorous batching protocols to ensure strict adherence to project specifications.

- Material Testing Knowledge: Experience with material testing, particularly in concrete and stabsand is essential.

What you'll bring

About MarkQ Homes
MarkQ Homes is a growing Sydney builder delivering project homes and custom-designed homes. We build on transparency, reliability and genuine care for our clients, and we’re expanding our team to keep up with demand.
About the Role
We’re looking for an experienced Project Coordinator to keep our residential builds running on time, on budget and to standard. Based in our Arncliffe office, you’ll be the link between our approvals team, site supervisors, trades and suppliers. You’ll manage schedules, support estimates and make sure every job has what it needs at each stage.
This is a hands-on role for someone who already knows how a residential build runs, from site start to handover, and is ready to take ownership.
Key Responsibilities
Construction Handover and Compliance
- Receive the project handover from our in-house approvals team once DA/CDC and Construction Certificate are in place, and review the approved plans, conditions of consent and specifications.
- Identify all construction-stage requirements, including conditions of consent, certifier inspections and required documentation, and build them into the construction program.
- Plan the construction sequence from site start through to completion, making sure every stage meets approval conditions, the National Construction Code and relevant Australian Standards.
- Schedule and track critical stage inspections with the certifier, and collect the certificates and compliance documents needed at each stage.
- Manage contracts, plans, specifications and construction records throughout the build.
- Coordinate the final documentation required for the Occupation Certificate and client handover.
Scheduling and Site Coordination
- Build and maintain construction programs for multiple active projects.
- Book and coordinate trades and suppliers in the right sequence to avoid delays.
- Work closely with site supervisors to track progress, resolve issues and keep milestones on target.
- Manage changes to the program and communicate updates to the team, trades and clients.
Estimating and Cost Control
- Prepare and assist with project estimates, quotes and take-offs.
- Obtain and compare trade and supplier quotes.
- Raise purchase orders, process invoices and prepare variations.
- Monitor project costs against budget and flag overruns early.
Communication
- Act as a key point of contact for trades, suppliers, consultants and internal teams.
- Follow up outstanding information and documents so nothing holds up the job.
- Support clear, professional communication with clients throughout the build.
What You’ll Bring
- At least 2–3 years’ experience in project coordination, scheduling or estimating in residential construction (essential).
- Strong knowledge of residential building stages, from site setup and slab through frame, lock-up, fit-off and completion.
- Understanding of building methods, materials, trade sequencing and construction terminology.
- Working knowledge of the National Construction Code, Australian Standards and NSW building compliance requirements.
- Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural and engineering plans and specifications.
- Proven experience coordinating trades and working closely with site teams.
- Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate issues, find practical solutions and keep the build moving when things don’t go to plan.
- Excellent time management and the ability to handle multiple projects and deadlines at once.
- Clear, professional written and verbal communication with trades, suppliers, team members and clients.
- High attention to detail and a proactive, take-ownership attitude.
- A willingness to learn, take feedback and grow with our processes and systems.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel and Outlook.
- Experience with construction management or scheduling software (highly regarded).
What We Offer
- A key role in a growing builder where your work has a visible impact.
- Variety across project homes and custom-designed homes.
- A clear career pathway towards Project Manager or Estimator roles.
- A supportive, close-knit team that values continuous improvement.
- Ongoing training and professional development.
How to Apply
If you’re organised, experienced in residential construction and know how to keep a build moving, we’d like to hear from you.

About the Role:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Mechanical Design Engineer / Team Leader to join our engineering team. Reporting directly to the Engineering Manager, you will play a pivotal role in the design, development, and optimisation of mechanical systems and components whilst leading a small team of design professionals in achieving technical excellence. 
This position requires a strong foundation in mechanical engineering principles, including experience with hydraulic components, advanced CAD proficiency, and a proactive approach to leadership, innovation, and continuous improvement. You will be responsible for providing technical direction, mentoring and developing engineering team members, and supporting the team's overall technical growth while ensuring the successful delivery of engineering projects.
The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with effective leadership skills, driving high-quality engineering outcomes while promoting a positive, accountable, and solutions focused team culture. You will work closely with cross functional stakeholders to deliver innovative, manufacturable, and reliable products that meet customer and business requirements.
Key Responsibilities:
- Perform detailed engineering analysis and simulations to enhance product performance and reliability
- Prepare comprehensive technical documentation, including engineering reports, detailed drawings, and specifications
- Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure design objectives and project requirements are met
- Develop 3D models and assemblies using Autodesk Inventor
- Generate manufacturing drawings, schematics, and Bills of Materials (BOMs)
- Contribute to research and development initiatives and support engineering innovation projects
- Participate in prototype development, testing, and validation of design concepts
- Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and prepare technical documentation for certification
- Understand hydraulic components, pumps, spool valves, solenoid valves, hydraulic torque motors and hydraulic cylinders
- Conduct tolerance analysis, stress and thermal analysis (FEA), and assess manufacturability
- Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) investigations
Leadership responsibilities:
- Lead, mentor, and support a small team of Mechanical Design Engineers, providing technical guidance and professional development opportunities.
- Allocate and prioritise engineering resources to ensure projects are delivered on time and to the required quality standards.
- Conduct design reviews and provide technical oversight to ensure compliance with engineering best practices and company standards.
- Drive a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, collaboration, and accountability within the engineering team.
- Support onboarding, and performance development activities for engineering personnel.
- Coach and develop team members in engineering methodologies, problem-solving techniques, and design best practices.
- Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating engineering teams in a design and manufacturing environment. Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to develop team capability and foster a high-performance culture.
Benefits:
- Opportunities for career progression and additional training
- Staff events such as company BBQs, Christmas Parties etc
- Free EAP service for staff and their families
- Fitness App
- Exclusive offers for well-known/leading brands and company’s 
- Wellbeing toolkits 
- Assessments and support programs covering Financial, Mental, Physical and Social Wellbeing
